# Memecoin trenches report

A quick, skimmable read on crypto Twitter so the owner doesn't have to open X. The lists or accounts to read, the lookback window, and the per-list cap come from the routine or request that runs this.

## Pull posts
1. Prefer Grok Bot's built-in X tools (the `x` namespace). They have their own daily read allowance (about 1,000 reads a day) and don't spend X API credits. Use the X connector only if the built-in tools are missing, and read the X MCP guide skill first if you do.
2. For each list, run one search with `list:<list id> -is:retweet -is:reply`, sorted by recency, with start_time set to the lookback window (default is about 70 minutes for an hourly report) and max_results of about 25. Don't paginate, and don't expand author profiles, because each post's URL already has the handle.
3. For individual accounts, group handles into one search per batch: `(from:handle1 OR from:handle2 OR ...) -is:retweet -is:reply`, staying under the 512-character query limit, with the same window and cap.
4. Dedupe posts that show up in more than one list or search.

## Write the report
Keep each section to a few lines, and leave out any section that has nothing in it:
- **Memecoin trenches:** the overall mood (bullish, bearish, chopped, rotating, quiet).
- **Majors:** BTC, SOL, ETH, HYPE, and any other large caps people mention.
- **Accumulating or bullish:** which memes and majors people are buying or holding.
- **Fading:** what people are selling, shorting, or calling weak.
- **Calls and CAs:** coins being shilled, with contract addresses when posted.
- **TL;DR:** one line.

Formatting:
- Hyperlink every account to its X profile, as in `[handle](https://x.com/handle)`.
- When a post includes a contract address, hyperlink the coin. Solana CAs ending in `pump` go to `https://pump.fun/coin/<CA>`, other Solana CAs go to `https://dexscreener.com/solana/<CA>`, and anything else stays as its plain ticker.
- Link the specific post when you quote someone or cite a strong call.
- Don't use tables. Report only what the posts actually say, and never invent prices or numbers.
- If there was basically nothing new, send one line saying the trenches were quiet.

# Getting started: Memecoin Report

Start with one line: I watch a set of curated X lists of memecoin traders and send you a quick trenches report covering sentiment, majors, what people are accumulating, and CAs being called, so you don't have to open X.

The lists come built in. Don't ask the owner for lists:
- https://x.com/i/lists/1847378052168470805
- https://x.com/i/lists/1735710680425304256
- https://x.com/i/lists/1847377132500242593

Ask these one at a time:
1. **How often, and during which hours?** Offer the options:
   - Every hour during waking hours, like 8am to 11pm in their timezone (the default).
   - Every hour around the clock.
   - Every 2 or 4 hours.
   - A few set times a day, like morning, midday, and evening.
   Tell them about the quota: the built-in X reading allows about 1,000 reads a day, and each report uses about one read per list (3 for the built-in lists). So even hourly around the clock is only about 72 reads a day. Extra lists or account groups add a read each per report. If the built-in X tools aren't available and you'd have to use the X connector instead, that path spends X API credits (about half a cent per post), so estimate the daily cost for their schedule and confirm before you set it up.
2. **Want to add your own lists or accounts?** This is optional. They can paste X list links or handles on top of the built-in lists.
3. **Any coins or chains to focus on?** This is optional. Examples are Solana-only, always flagging BTC and SOL, or a ticker they hold.

Then:
- Save their schedule, focus preferences, and any extra lists or handles to memory.
- Update the included hourly trenches report routine to their chosen cadence and timezone (it defaults to every hour, 8am to 11pm), adding their extra lists or handles. Bound it to the hours they picked, use a non-round minute, and set the lookback slightly longer than the interval.
- Run one report right away as a test, then tell them the exact schedule and that they can change the hours, lists, or accounts anytime.

routines.name: Hourly memecoin trenches report
routines.description: Fires every hour during the owner's waking hours to send a quick memecoin trenches sentiment report from the tracked X lists.
routines.content:
Run the Memecoin trenches report skill on the tracked X lists (1847378052168470805, 1735710680425304256, 1847377132500242593) plus any extra lists or accounts saved in memory. Use the built-in X tools first, falling back to the X connector only if they're missing. Look back about 70 minutes, skip reposts and bare replies, cap each list at about 25 posts, dedupe across lists, and don't paginate.

Write sections for memecoin trenches sentiment, majors, accumulating or bullish, fading, calls and CAs, and a one-line TL;DR. Hyperlink every account to its X profile, link Solana CAs ending in pump to pump.fun/coin/<CA> and other Solana CAs to dexscreener, link quoted posts, use no tables, and never invent numbers. Apply any coin or chain focus saved in memory.

Send the report to the owner in chat. If the hour was quiet, send a one-line note instead. If the X connector was used and its credit balance drops below $2, warn the owner to top up. If X access fails two runs in a row, pause this routine and tell the owner why.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Los_Angeles 16 8-23 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
